stories.title: Daniel Dubois delivers devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley to retain WBO title
stories.brief: Davison had been on the brink of throwing in the towel at the very end of the opening round but the bell sounded to end a disastrous first three minutes for Wardley. He was dropped heavily after just 17 seconds as Dubois landed a left cross followed by a pulverising right hand.

stories.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
stories.brief: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Dubois destroys Wardley in two rounds to retain title
stories.brief: WBO champion Daniel Dubois underlines his status as Britain's leading heavyweight with a devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley.

stories.title: Cockfighting finds a ring under police watch
stories.brief: Despite restrictions on cockfighting, a regular market for the sale and fighting of specially bred Aseel gamecocks has reportedly emerged near City Police Station in Rawalpindi, with contests and trading taking place every Friday at Dingi Khoi Chowk.

stories.title: Mystery deaths raise water safety fears
stories.brief: According to World Health Organisation (WHO) statistics, Pakistan recorded a mortality rate of 38.8 deaths per 100,000 people in 2019 attributable to unsafe water, poor sanitation and inadequate hygiene facilities.

stories.title: Trade at Taftan comes to a grinding halt
stories.brief: Cross-border commercial activities between Pakistan and Iran on Saturday halted suddenly at the Taftan border crossing. The border closure coincides with regulatory developments from the Ministry of Commerce.

stories.title: Railways logs over 55 accidents this year
stories.brief: Accidents Pakistan Railways has recorded more than 55 accidents involving passenger and freight trains since January 1, raising concerns over railway safety, maintenance standards and the effectiveness of measures announced to prevent mishaps. The Yusufwala coal train has reportedly been involved in several accidents.

stories.title: Security forces respond to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban along Kurram border: state media
stories.brief: Security forces have responded to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban forces along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Upper Kurram, state broadcaster PTV News reported on Saturday.

stories.title: Several Afghan Taliban posts destroyed as Pakistan responds to Kurram border firing: state media
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army responded to unprovoked firing by the Afghan Taliban in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Upper Kurram and Ghozgarhi, with several Taliban personnel reportedly killed in the retaliatory action, state media reported on Saturday.

stories.title: Govt notifies 48-member Area Representative and Development Council for 12 K-P districts
stories.brief: The federal government on Saturday formally notified the establishment of the 48-member Area Representative and Development Council (ARDC) across 12 districts of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) as the governor consolidated his rule in the province.

stories.title: ‘Serious incident’ at Alberta military base causes deaths and injuries, Canada officials say
stories.brief: Patients being taken to hospitals in Edmonton as Wainwright ‘completely overwhelmed’ by number of injuries, local doctor says People have been killed and injured after an incident at one of Canada’s busiest military training bases in Alberta caused a large fire, Canada’s defence minister said Saturday.“I’m saddened to share that there have been both fatalities…

stories.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
stories.brief: Demonstrations across the country turned violent, with cars and buildings set alight and shops ransacked.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
stories.brief: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.(Image credit: Andrew Medichini)

stories.title: Avian flu and costs among reasons for loss of captive birds at Castle Espie
stories.brief: Difficulties in transporting animals since Brexit has contributed to the decline in the number of captive birds.

stories.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
stories.brief: The Australian government hopes to protect social media users from being served content they don't want to see.

stories.title: Canada reports deaths after 'incident' on military base in Alberta
stories.brief: Prime Minister Mark Carney had posted to X earlier on Saturday that “a serious incident creating a major fire” had occurred at the base.

stories.title: One in three adults in Pakistan lives with psychological disorder: study
stories.brief: KARACHI: Pakistan’s first nationally representative mental health survey has shown that nearly one in three adults is living with a diagnosable mental and behavioural disorder, highlighting a major public health challenge affecting millions of people across the country.

stories.title: Digging for Red Line damages gas pipeline, disrupts supply in Karachi
stories.brief: The disruption affected Gulshan-i-Iqbal, areas around Mazar-i-Quaid, parts of Garden, Saddar, Burns Road and several other localities. A spokesperson for the Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) said that the high-pressure pipeline near the Gulshan-i-Iqbal telephone exchange on University Road was damaged at around 1pm during BRT construction activity.

stories.title: Arguments sought on defamation suit against PTI founder
stories.brief: Earlier, Khan’s counsel, Muhammad Hussain Chotia, argued for permission to meet his client at Adiala Jail, Rawalpindi, saying he needed instructions from him regarding the case and his signatures on documents. He asked the court to direct the jail superintendent to permit him to meet Khan.

stories.title: Balochistan CM Bugti urges Fazl to keep national security above politics
stories.brief: He stressed that comparisons between the governments of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, particularly regarding terrorism and national security, must be based on ground realities and practical measures.
